_comment: Google's Gemini voices: the thirty prebuilt voices SUB/WAVE's own Gemini engine speaks (Kore, Puck, Charon...). Picking this adapter fills Endpoint in. The key is the Google / Gemini key under Brains, the same one a Gemini brain uses; there is no separate voice key. 'Station's voice for this DJ' gives a DJ the station voices through Gemini that exact voice, and any other DJ speaks as the voice picked under Voice (or Kore, first below). The text is read verbatim; no style prompt is sent. gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts streams first audio in about a second (measured 2026-10-04 on the operator's key: 0.9s to first audio, a 3.1s line in 1.7s), gemini-3.8-flash-tts is fuller and about half a second slower. Test voice cannot vary the format to measure the rate, and does not need to: Google states 24000 on every chunk.
